title: Very disappointed
text: Very disappointed. I loved this crockpot until the digital quit and I can no longer program anything or use it. I'm so disappointed that it just stop working and went blank, no lights, no way to know if it's on or off nothing. Plus it happened conveniently when the warranty was up.

product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach Portable 6 Quart Set & Forget Digital Programmable Slow Cooker with Lid Lock, Temperature Probe & Defrost Setting, Dishwasher Safe Crock & Lid, Silver (33869)
features: GREAT FOR FROZEN MEAT — DEFROSTS FIRST, THEN COOKS IT UNTIL PERFECTLY DONE: This slow cooker knows how to defrost and cook food safely without overcooking. Simply press defrost, select high or low and your cooking time — slow cooker will do the rest.

ENSURE PERFECT RESULTS WITH TEMPERATURE PROBE: Cook meat to a precise temperature without overcooking it. Set this programmable slow cooker to the desired temperature, insert probe and it will automatically shift to warm when food is ready.

CLIP-TIGHT LID FOR MESS-FREE TRAVEL. Take this portable slow cooker to parties or on the road with worrying about spills. The clip-tight lid locks in place to improve portability and help prevent spills.
SERVES 7+ PEOPLE WITH 6 QUART CAPACITY: This 6 quart slow cooker's size is perfect for preparing one-pot dishes, family meals or crowd-pleasing appetizers and it fits a 6 lb. chicken or 4 lb. roast.

FLEXIBLE TIME AND TEMPERATURE OPTIONS. Choose high, low or warm and set the cooking timer between 30 minutes and 24 hours — the timer will display the remaining time. To cook without setting a time, use the manual mode and set your preferred temperature.
description: The innovative defrosting and cooking ability of the Hamilton Beach® Set & Forget® Defrost Slow Cooker lets you safely cook frozen meat without overcooking it. Includes temperature probe, clip-tight lid and flexible programming options.
